question: How much monthly pension can I get under Atal Pension Yojana?
answer: Under APY the subscriber selects a minimum pension of Rs. 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 per month, given at the age of 60 years.

question: अटल पेंशन योजना में हर महीने कितनी पेंशन मिल सकती है?
Atal Pension Yojana mein har mahine kitni pension mil sakti hai?
answer: 60 saal ki age par har mahine Rs. 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 ya 5,000 ki minimum pension milti hai.

question: How much land can a farmer own to count as a small and marginal farmer under PM-KMY?
answer: A Small and Marginal Farmer is a farmer who owns cultivable land upto 2 hectare as per land records of the State/UT.

question: I have accounts in two banks. Can I join PMJJBY through both?
answer: No. The person is eligible to join the scheme through one bank / Post office account only.

question: Can a farmer who paid income tax last year join PM-KMY?
answer: No. All persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded.

question: पिछले साल आयकर देने वाला किसान क्या पीएम-केएमवाई में शामिल हो सकता है?
answer: नहीं, पिछले आकलन वर्ष में आयकर देने वाले सभी व्यक्ति इस योजना से बाहर हैं।

question: From when is PM-KMY effective?
answer: The scheme is effective from the 9th August, 2019.

question: How much do I have to contribute every month to PM-KMY?
answer: The amount of the monthly contribution ranges between Rs. 55 and Rs. 200 per month depending upon the age of entry into the scheme.

question: पीएम-केएमवाई में हर महीने कितना योगदान देना होता है?
answer: प्रवेश की आयु के अनुसार हर महीने ₹55 से ₹200 तक का योगदान देना होता है।

question: Is the first LPG refill free under PMUY?
answer: Yes. All PMUY beneficiaries are provided the first LPG refill and stove (hotplate) both free of cost by the Oil Marketing Companies.

question: Who can get an LPG connection under Ujjwala Yojana?
answer: An adult woman from a poor household can apply, and there should not be any other LPG connection in the same household.

question: उज्ज्वला योजना में एलपीजी कनेक्शन किसे मिल सकता है?
answer: गरीब परिवार की वयस्क महिला को, बशर्ते उसी घर में कोई दूसरा एलपीजी कनेक्शन न हो।

question: Ujjwala Yojana mein LPG connection kisko mil sakta hai?
answer: Gareeb parivaar ki adult mahila ko, agar ghar mein koi aur LPG connection na ho.

question: Who becomes the nominee in APY if I am married?
answer: If the subscriber is married, the spouse will be the default nominee.

question: Can an NRI open an APY account?
answer: Yes. An NRI in the age group 18-40 years having a bank account with APY POP is eligible to open an APY account.

question: What is the yearly premium for PMJJBY?
answer: The premium is Rs. 436 per annum per member.

question: PMJJBY ka saal ka premium kitna hai?
answer: Har member ka premium Rs. 436 per annum hai.

question: What is the cover period of PMJJBY?
answer: The cover is for a one-year period stretching from 1st June to 31st May.

question: What is the price of an LPG refill after the free first refill under PMUY?
answer: The provided documents do not mention the price of later refills.

question: What is the helpline number for Atal Pension Yojana?
answer: The provided documents do not mention a helpline number.

question: अटल पेंशन योजना का हेल्पलाइन नंबर क्या है?
answer: दिए गए दस्तावेज़ों में हेल्पलाइन नंबर नहीं दिया गया है।

question: How is the PMSBY premium paid?
answer: The premium is deducted from the account holder's bank or Post office account through the auto debit facility in one instalment.

question: PM-KMY ki pension kis tareekh ko account mein aati hai?
answer: Diye gaye documents mein pension aane ki tareekh nahi batayi gayi hai.

question: Which bank gives the highest interest on APY contributions?
answer: The provided documents do not say which bank gives the highest interest.

question: I am 40 years old. Can I still join Atal Pension Yojana?
answer: No. Currently a person in the age group of 18 years to 39 years 364 days can join Atal Pension Yojana.

question: Meri age 40 saal ho gayi hai, kya main APY join kar sakta hoon?
answer: Nahi. Abhi sirf 18 saal se 39 saal 364 din tak ke log APY join kar sakte hain.

question: I am already in the National Pension Scheme. Can I join PM-KMY?
answer: No. Small and Marginal Farmers covered under any other social security scheme such as the National Pension Scheme (NPS) are under the exclusion criteria.

question: How much does PMSBY pay if someone loses sight of one eye in an accident?
answer: For total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye, the sum insured is Rs. 1 Lakh.

question: I am a government employee. Can I join APY?
answer: Yes. Any Indian citizen within the age group of 18 - 40 years can join APY irrespective of his/her employment status with Govt./Public Sector.

question: How much cash assistance does the government give for a PMUY connection?
answer: Government of India provides cash assistance of Rs. 1600 for a connection with a 14.2 kg cylinder or Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder.

question: उज्ज्वला कनेक्शन के लिए सरकार कितनी नकद सहायता देती है?
answer: 14.2 किलो सिलेंडर वाले कनेक्शन के लिए ₹1600 और 5 किलो सिलेंडर के लिए ₹1150।

question: Ujjwala connection ke liye sarkar kitni cash madad deti hai?
answer: 14.2 kg cylinder wale connection ke liye Rs. 1600 aur 5 kg cylinder ke liye Rs. 1150.

question: Is Aadhaar needed for Atal Pension Yojana?
answer: APY is included under Section 7 of the Aadhaar Act, so an individual eligible for benefits under APY has to furnish proof of possession of Aadhaar number or undergo Aadhaar authentication.

question: Who is eligible to join PM-KMY?
answer: All Small and Marginal Farmers of the age of 18 years and above and upto the age of 40 years, who do not fall within the exclusion criteria, are eligible to join the scheme.

question: PM-KMY ke liye kaun eligible hai?
answer: 18 se 40 saal ke sabhi chhote aur seemant kisan jo exclusion criteria mein nahi aate, is scheme ko join kar sakte hain.

question: Up to what age does the PMJJBY cover continue?
answer: The assurance terminates on attaining age 55 years, and entry is not possible beyond the age of 50 years.

question: पीएमजेजेबीवाई का बीमा किस उम्र तक चलता है?
answer: 55 वर्ष की आयु पूरी होने पर बीमा समाप्त हो जाता है, और 50 वर्ष के बाद नई एंट्री नहीं हो सकती।

question: Does PMJJBY pay for hospital bills?
answer: The provided documents do not mention payment of hospital bills.

question: How much money is paid under PMJJBY if the member dies?
answer: Rs. 2 lakh is payable on the member's death due to any cause.

question: पीएमजेजेबीवाई में सदस्य की मृत्यु पर कितना पैसा मिलता है?
answer: किसी भी कारण से सदस्य की मृत्यु होने पर ₹2 लाख दिए जाते हैं।

question: PMJJBY mein death hone par kitna paisa milta hai?
answer: Kisi bhi wajah se member ki death hone par Rs. 2 lakh milte hain.

question: What documents are needed for a PMUY connection?
answer: KYC, a ration card or other State Govt. document certifying family composition, Aadhaar of the beneficiary and adult family members, proof of address, and bank account number and IFSC.

question: PMUY ke liye kaun se documents chahiye?
answer: KYC, ration card, beneficiary aur family ke adult members ka Aadhaar, address proof, aur bank account number aur IFSC.

question: What is the premium for PMSBY?
answer: The premium payable is Rs. 20 per annum per member.

question: पीएमएसबीवाई का प्रीमियम कितना है?
answer: प्रीमियम ₹20 प्रति वर्ष प्रति सदस्य है।

question: PMSBY ka premium kitna hai?
answer: Premium Rs. 20 per annum per member hai.

question: पीएमएसबीवाई का दावा कितने दिनों में मिलता है?
answer: दिए गए दस्तावेज़ों में दावा निपटान का समय नहीं बताया गया है।

question: If I join PMJJBY in March, how much premium do I pay?
answer: For enrolment in March, April and May, a pro rata premium of Rs. 114 is payable.

question: What is the minimum age to apply for PMUY?
answer: The applicant must have attained 18 years of age.

question: What pension does PM Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana give?
answer: Each subscriber shall receive a minimum assured pension of Rs. 3000 per month after attaining the age of 60 years.

question: पीएम किसान मान-धन योजना में कितनी पेंशन मिलती है?
answer: 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद हर महीने कम से कम ₹3000 की पेंशन मिलती है।

question: PM-KMY mein pension kitni milti hai?
answer: 60 saal ki umar ke baad har mahine kam se kam Rs. 3000 pension milti hai.

question: Who can join Atal Pension Yojana?
answer: Any citizen of India between 18 and 40 years of age who has a savings bank account or post office savings bank account can join APY.

question: अटल पेंशन योजना में कौन शामिल हो सकता है?
answer: 18 से 40 वर्ष की आयु का कोई भी भारतीय नागरिक, जिसका बचत बैंक खाता या डाकघर बचत खाता है, APY में शामिल हो सकता है।

question: APY mein kaun join kar sakta hai?
answer: 18 se 40 saal ka koi bhi Indian citizen jiska savings bank ya post office savings account hai, APY join kar sakta hai.

question: What is the age limit to join PMSBY?
answer: Bank or Post office account holders in the age group of 18 to 70 years are entitled to join.

question: PMSBY join karne ki age limit kya hai?
answer: 18 se 70 saal ke bank ya post office account holders join kar sakte hain.

question: How much does PMSBY pay on accidental death?
answer: Rs. 2 Lakh is payable on death due to accident.

question: पीएमएसबीवाई में दुर्घटना से मृत्यु पर कितना पैसा मिलता है?
answer: दुर्घटना से मृत्यु होने पर ₹2 लाख मिलते हैं।

question: PMSBY mein accident se death hone par kitna milta hai?
answer: Accident se death hone par Rs. 2 lakh milte hain.
